blocks.text: Updated at 3:39 P.M. MANILA, Philippines — Vice Admiral Rommel Supangan is the new commandant of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), replacing Ronnie Gil Gavan, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro announced on Monday. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. led the change-of-command and retirement ceremony for Supangan and Gavan at the Coast Guard Fleet in the Port Area, City of Manila, on Monday. Supangan, a graduate of the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) “Marilag” Class of 1995, has served in the PCG for more than three decades, holding key leadership positions in maritime operations, environmental protection, and strategic affairs.
